:::{#def-linear-decay}
#### Linear decay

Let $\schedlen$ be a number of updates, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
and let $\iterpoint{\steplen}{0}, \iterpoint{\steplen}{\schedlen} > 0$ be the [step lengths](#def-gradient-descent) before update $1$ and after update $\schedlen$.
The **linear decay** schedule is

$$
\iterpoint{\steplen}{t} \eqdef \paren{1 - \schedfrac}\,\iterpoint{\steplen}{0} + \schedfrac\,\iterpoint{\steplen}{\schedlen},
\qquad
\schedfrac \eqdef \minf{\frac{t}{\schedlen}, 1}.
$$

:::
